purpose: Coordination file between GitHub cleanup session and project doctor session
instructions_for_doctor: This file was created by the GitHub cleanup session. After the user runs the 4 numbered scripts on their Desktop, the doctor session should verify everything worked correctly.

scripts.name: 3-extract-projects.bat
scripts.action: Creates 6 new repos from exo branches, then deletes those branches

scripts.name: 4-doctor-and-cleanup.bat
scripts.action: Runs health checks, writes report, deletes all scripts including itself

doctor_checklist: Verify exo repo only has master + claude/distributed-claude-agents-oR46c branches
Verify all 6 new repos exist and have content on main branch
Verify local ProjectHub server starts: python server.py
Verify project-hub.json files are present in project directories
Verify Docker Compose config is valid in distributed-claude-agents
Check Desktop for project-health-report.txt after user runs scripts
Check Desktop for .doctor-results.json for machine-readable results
